entry.title: Azure/azure-sdk-for-net - Releases - 2026-06-29
entry.content:
Azure.Provisioning.CostManagement_1.0.0-beta.1

1.0.0-beta.1 (2026-06-26)

Features Added

  • Initial beta release of Azure.Provisioning.CostManagement with support for declarative Cost Management resource provisioning.

  • Added support for Cost Management Export, View, and Scheduled Action resources.

  • Generated with the new TypeSpec-based provisioning generator
    (@azure-typespec/http-client-csharp-provisioning).
